subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 50 to
guide_solution: Summary Friction between teenagers and parents is very much common. It does not occur in all homes and it can be avaoded if the parents are wise, cordial, co-operative, compromising, tolerant and understanding in their dealings with teenaged boys and girls. Moody, sulky quarrelsome and obstinate behaviours are common characteristics that lead to friction between the teen-aged children and their parents. We should all keep aloof from friction.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Govt. S.C. Girls' High School, Sunamganj. Sl. No. 110; Page No. 155
